issues.issue: Whether the denied US detentions and biometric records undermine credibility
issues.applicant_position: Refugees sometimes use false identities for safety, citing Federal Court case law.
issues.respondent_position: Biometric records show two US DHS fingerprinting encounters and a 2002 apprehension; the appellant and wife denied them.
issues.result_text: Biometric evidence is reliable; undisclosed encounters seriously impugn the appellant's and wife's credibility.

issues.issue: Whether the MS-13 extortion, father's killing and the police report are credible
issues.applicant_position: Trauma caused memory lapses; the police report was obtained through a friend at the police station.
issues.result_text: Contradictions on father's death; police report found not genuine; gang killing of father not established.

issues.issue: Whether gang extortion visits to the appellant's mother are established
issues.applicant_position: Gang visited mother every 2-3 months for extortion money; two letters corroborate this.
issues.result_text: Mother's harassment not established; BOC omission and contradictory letters give the letters no probative value.
